historical_root_cause_audit.description: Evaluation loader included development_train samples in validation metrics
historical_root_cause_audit.historical_script: run_smoke_local.py (local notebook script, never committed to git)
historical_root_cause_audit.root_cause_explanation: Evaluation dataset filter incorrectly included development_train samples. The buggy filter condition was: if row['partition'] == partition and (partition != 'inner_validation' or row['lc_n50'] == 'True'). When partition='development_train', the condition partition != 'inner_validation' evaluates to True, making the entire OR condition True regardless of lc_n50 value. This caused 50 development_train sources (100 samples) to be included in validation metrics.
historical_root_cause_audit.runner_filter_logic: val_instances = [inst for inst in instances if inst.partition == 'inner_validation']
historical_root_cause_audit.notebook_fix_commit: 24adfce1 (documented fix in notebook, but run_smoke_local.py was never in git)
